subtasks.title: Inspect inventory and recipe dependencies
subtasks.prompt: Inspect current inventory and identify the next missing dependency in the supplied recipe graph.
subtasks.success_criterion: A concrete missing raw material or craftable intermediate is identified.

subtasks.title: Gather raw materials
subtasks.prompt: Get enough non-craftable raw material for every remaining recipe batch.
subtasks.success_criterion: The required raw material is present in sufficient quantity.

subtasks.title: Craft intermediates and target
subtasks.prompt: Execute one supplied crafting command whose ingredients are already available.
subtasks.success_criterion: An intermediate or the target is crafted without an invalid recipe.
